verdict.rationale: Store Sync is a documented catalog-publishing path: merchants submit a validated feed file using one of three supported specs (Google Product Feed, OpenAI ACP Product Feed, and a third) as CSV/TSV/PSV up to 4 GB with defined required fields, explicitly 'enabling AI agents to discover your products'. Partner on-ramps (Wix, Cymbio, BigCommerce/Feedonomics, Shopware) offer an alternative import route. Access is form-gated and limited to US physical goods in USD, missing for 10: self-serve access, support for digital/subscription/non-US catalogs, explicit naming of which agent surfaces consume the feed, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
